nodes.label: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? From Noisy Teacher to Self-Improvement
nodes.author: Yi Ding, Ruqi Zhang
nodes.rationale: Analyzes teacher supervision noise in OPD, discovers student insensitivity to noise, identifies low-logp token suppression as key mechanism, proposes OPSA with entropy-adaptive negative advantages.

nodes.label: On-Policy Distillation (OPD)
nodes.rationale: Uses strong teacher to provide token-level advantages via reverse KL on student-sampled trajectories; requires white-box teacher access; 30.6-50.6% noise rate in teacher supervision.

nodes.label: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD)
nodes.rationale: Replaces external teacher with policy conditioned on hints (e.g., reference answers); still requires additional sampling/annotation and risks information leakage.

nodes.label: On-Policy Self-Adaptation (OPSA)
nodes.rationale: Supervision-free method; assigns entropy-adaptive negative advantages to lowest-20%-logp tokens; suppresses tail tokens, redistributes mass among head tokens; improves Avg@32 by 263-307% on math benchmarks.

nodes.label: Noisy Teacher Signals Analysis
nodes.rationale: Noise defined as advantage sign disagreement with verifiable reward; 20.4% correct answers receive negative advantages, 40.8% incorrect receive positive; noise increases with teacher scale to 50.6%.

nodes.label: Low Log-Probability Token Suppression
nodes.rationale: OPD gains concentrate on lowest-logp tokens; high-logp tokens provide negligible gradients; fixed negative advantages on low-logp tokens match OPD performance.

nodes.label: Entropy-Adaptive Negative Advantages
nodes.rationale: Magnitude scales with token entropy (δ=1); high-entropy positions receive stronger negative signals; preserves diversity at fork tokens while sharpening low-entropy positions.

nodes.label: Reflective Long-Form Reasoning
nodes.rationale: OPSA elicits more reflective tokens ('wait', 'but', 'perhaps'); response length increases during training; positive correlation between length and accuracy.

nodes.label: Qwen3 Model Family
nodes.rationale: Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, Qwen3.5-9B evaluated; OPSA improves Avg@32 by 263-307% on AIME24/AIME25/HMMT25.

nodes.label: DAPO-17k Dataset
nodes.rationale: Training dataset for OPSA; 17k mathematical reasoning questions without labels or ground-truth answers.
